Name: Vu's Motorcycle Styles
Author: an4tocom
Description:
Add more variety motorcycle and garage styles, include a RED CRUISER base on Sebation's motorcycle, a v-twin motorcycle and a xich lo (cyclo) - symbol of Vietnam tourism.

[/center][left][u]How to install:

[/u][/left]1. Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url]﻿ installed. Optionally install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to access settings while in game.
2. Download the Zip file and extract into your Mods folder.
3. Run the game through SMAPI.
4. Enjoy!!!
